name: Est
summary:
Est is a guessing game published in the CURSOR cassette magazine for the Commodore PET.

There are two game modes. In the first game mode, a bar of a random length is displayed on the screen. The goal of the game is to estimate the length of the bar (in centimeters) as closely as possible. Up to one decimal can be entered. If the guess is within a certain range of the correct length, it will count as a good guess and score a point. After each guess, the player can decide to go for another round or quit the game. Once the player quits, the game will show the percentage of correct guesses and overall score.

In the second game mode, a rectangle of random size is displayed on the screen instead of a bar. The player then estimates its area (in square centimeters). The player can choose the game mode at the beginning of the game.
